name: Swedish Relaxation Massage
description: Gentle, flowing strokes that melt away tension and calm the mind.
details: Our signature full-body massage uses light to medium pressure with warm, nourishing oil. Long, rhythmic strokes ease tight muscles, improve circulation and help your whole body settle into deep relaxation. Ideal for first-time guests and anyone who wants to simply unwind.
benefits: Reduces stress and helps you sleep better

name: Hot Stone Therapy
description: Smooth heated stones release deep tension and leave you feeling lighter.
details: Heated basalt stones are placed along key points of the body and used by your therapist to massage deeper layers of muscle. The steady warmth softens knots, relaxes the nervous system and brings a long-lasting sense of calm.

name: Radiance Facial
description: A deep-cleansing facial that restores your skin's natural glow.
details: Your therapist begins with a skin analysis, then cleanses, gently exfoliates, steams and applies a hydrating mask matched to your skin type. A relaxing face, neck and shoulder massage finishes the treatment, leaving skin fresh, soft and bright.

name: Aromatherapy Ritual
description: A full sensory journey with essential oils, candlelight and slow, mindful touch.
details: Choose a blend of pure essential oils, such as lavender, ylang ylang or citrus, and enjoy a slow, 90-minute massage in a softly lit room. Breathing guidance and calming scents help quiet a busy mind and restore a sense of balance.
benefits: Calms the mind and eases anxiety
includes: Essential oil blend of your choice

name: Body Scrub & Glow
description: A natural exfoliating scrub followed by a moisturizing wrap for silky skin.
details: Gentle sea salt and botanical oils buff away dead skin, then a rich body butter is massaged in to seal in moisture. Skin feels smoother, softer and visibly more radiant, perfect before a special occasion or simply as a treat.

name: Manicure & Pedicure Set
description: Complete hand and foot care with a relaxing soak and polish of your choice.
details: Enjoy a warm soak, nail shaping, cuticle care, gentle exfoliation and a short hand and foot massage, finished with the polish color of your choice. A tidy, polished look that keeps you feeling fresh.
